versions.changelog:
Initial release featuring 136 core medical imaging and interventional radiology skills, based on the 9th edition of the official Chinese textbook.

- Covers diagnosis and intervention using X-ray, CT, MRI, ultrasound, and interventional techniques.
- Organized into categories such as imaging principles, AI in imaging, anatomy-based diagnostics, and clinical decision support.
- Includes structured skill listings for core disease patterns, technical procedures, safety protocols, and imaging report interpretation.
- Designed for clinical education and practical reference in medical imaging and radiology.
